alignments.note: Negative particle to the postposed *not*; the ASV writes a separate word for it, so no fusion with the verb under rule 35 arises.
Finite verb to the lexical *roasteth* (rule 17). The margin's *Or, catcheth not his prey* was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.

Abstract noun *slackness* rendered as a personal substantive *The slothful man*. The supplied *the* determines the nominal expression under rule 15 and the generic *man* completes it under rule 31; head on *slothful*, whose loss loses the lexeme, since *man* alone is any man.

The noun *game/prey* is recast as an English head phrase with a relative clause, so the supplied *that which* and the verbal phrase *took in hunting* belong to the noun's own unit under rule 46's closing paragraph, no clause standing in the Hebrew for the relative to subordinate. Head on *hunting*, which carries the lexeme; the competing head is *took*, but *took* alone names no quarry.
Possessive suffix realized as the subject pronoun *he* of the recast relative clause (rule 18, which places whatever English pronoun realizes the suffix).
Waw rendered by the adversative *But*, which rule 14 places on the connective morpheme the ASV wrote it for.

Construct noun *wealth* → *substance*. No article morpheme stands in the phrase, so the single written *the* is the supplied determiner of the nominal expression and joins this noun rather than the adjective it stands before (rules 15 and 29).
Nomen rectum with the chain's relational *of* (rule 19), headed on the noun.
Attributive adjective to its own word *precious*; the phrase's determiner is the construct noun's under rule 15.

Anarthrous substantival adjective construed by the ASV as the predicate of the verbless clause: the construction-supplied copula *is* joins the predicate under rule 20, the supplied *to* states what this bare nominal contributes under rule 33, and the supplied *the* makes it substantival under rule 46. Head on *diligent*, which carries the lexeme. The margin's *Or, is to be diligent* was read and set aside under rule 38.

review_notes: All 10 source and 21 target IDs partitioned exactly once.
Both ASV marginal notes (*Or, catcheth not his prey*; *Or, is to be diligent*) were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

The ASV italics on *is* and *to* corroborate but do not decide their placement (rule 7): *is* is rule 20's construction-supplied copula and *to* is rule 33's supplied function word for a bare nominal, so neither is `added`.
The materially different reading available at s004 is heading the recast phrase on *took* rather than *hunting*; noted in the unit.
